issues.description: Function name mismatch: the exercise specification and reference solution require a function named create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate, but the template defines create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate instead. Problem statement (tensor networks task) instructs implement create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate; solution_repository/tensor_networks.py provides create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate; template_repository/tensor_networks.py only provides create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This inconsistency will confuse students and cause tests or instructor examples that call create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate to fail against the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by either renaming the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (updating its signature and any internal refs) or add a short compatibility wrapper in the template: def create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate(gate_matrix): return create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate(gate_matrix). This preserves the educational intent while removing the naming mismatch.

issues.description: The concept is the nearest-neighbor two-qubit gate tensor used in the tensor-network simulator. The problem statement refers to this function as create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate. The template repository declares a function named create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate (template_repository/tensor_networks.py), while the solution implements create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (solution_repository/tensor_networks.py). This mismatch (create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate vs create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate) prevents students from directly mapping the task name in the problem text/tests to the stub in the template, causing confusion about which function to implement and possibly breaking tests that expect the problem-statement name.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier across all artifacts. Rename the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and update its docstring) so it matches the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, rename the problem statement and solution to use create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate — but prefer changing the template to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate to match the tests and problem text. Also update any references in tests, docstrings, and examples to use the unified name.
